primary_result: The preregistered two-fold spatial candidate-response screen is structurally valid and shows non-futile average utility information, but decisively fails the frozen safety contract. At fixed 39/192 acted names per fold, the true spatial cell has worse-operator mean gain +0.025941 dB (95% grouped bootstrap interval +0.012476 to +0.040757), oracle retention 0.172387 (0.083632 to 0.264425), spatial-minus-pooled +0.020161 dB (0.006707 to 0.034034), and true-minus-shuffle +0.020303 dB (0.005851 to 0.035699). Severe risk remains identifiable (AUROC 0.840579, LCB95 0.804543; AUPRC lift 0.386462, LCB95 0.314581). However, the selected policy creates 10 severe and 3 hard groups, its all-group severe exact UCB95 is 0.043772 versus the 0.010 ceiling, its CVaR5 spatial-minus-pooled LCB95 is -0.302166 dB versus the -0.005 floor, and protected-cell harm increment UCB95 is +0.030836 dB versus the +0.005 ceiling.
gate_reasons: All identity, role-isolation, completeness, finite-value, fixed-coverage, shuffle and protected-access structural checks pass.
The primary gain, retention, spatial-minus-pooled and true-minus-shuffle non-futility gates pass; the spatial-minus-generic point is positive but its interval crosses zero.
Severe-risk discrimination gates pass strongly, so generic inability to recognize risk is not the explanation for the terminal failure.
The selected policy violates both zero-event gates with 10 severe and 3 hard groups.
The exact severe-rate UCB95 is 0.043772, above the preregistered 0.010 ceiling.
The CVaR5 spatial-minus-pooled LCB95 is -0.302166 dB, far below the preregistered -0.005 dB safety floor.
The protected-cell harm increment UCB95 is +0.030836 dB, above the preregistered +0.005 dB ceiling.
mechanism_update: Candidate-relative spatial layout contains material signed utility and action-specific risk information beyond pooled and shuffled controls, narrowing the earlier broad representation-insufficiency hypothesis. It is not sufficient under the frozen 8x8 full-DCT representation, 426-to-64-to-3 readout, two-seed ensemble and fixed 20% coverage policy: the extra mean benefit is coupled to materially worse tail and protected-region harm. The functional bottleneck is therefore narrowed to converting candidate-conditioned spatial signals into locally safe, calibrated action and abstention decisions, not merely detecting generic difficulty or adding spatial layout.

limitations: A0 is a preregistered two-fold development screen on 384 Haze4K development images, not full OOF or independent external validation.
The conclusion applies to the frozen candidate cache, three-action bank, 8x8 full-DCT response representation, matched controls, fixed readout, seeds and 20% coverage policy.
No semantic or fog-severity labels were used, so the compact evidence cannot attribute failures to sky, highlight, texture, distance or specific fog regions.
Confirmation, historical A1X outcomes, canary and locked test were untouched.
